mechanism: Sacubitril (ARNI) and dapagliflozin (SGLT2i) both reduce blood pressure and may cause additive hypotension and volume depletion, with potential for worsening renal function and euglycemic DKA risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure, renal function, and volume status closely; ensure adequate hydration; use combination cautiously in patients with eGFR <30 mL/min or acute illness.
